text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, in the evening—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(To think I actually forgot something in the classroom...
It could have waited until tomorrow, but
I might as well get it back today—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...? Is someone talking in the classroom...?)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Are you truly all right with that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I've already... been left behind, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So... I am thinking of...
retiring from racing within this year...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to talk to you briefly today...
So, please excuse me now.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O-san!
You really ought to think this through one more time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Ardan-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry!
I did not mean to eavesdrop.
However, what you just said—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Wait, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why... Why are you consulting me about retiring?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Your legs are gradually recovering.
In fact, you've become able to come to the Academy like this, and even start running again...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Could you... tell me the reason?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness. Nobody's here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Right after the Derby.
When it was decided I'd be hospitalized...――"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I still...
"I'm gonna make a proper comeback and give it my all again," I thought...
That's what I truly believed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
During all that time I couldn't train, watching
the Twinkle Series at home and in the hospital...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gradually, I started to get scared...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —I watched every single one of your races, Ardan-san, Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can tell... that you're both
getting stronger and stronger...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"She's so amazing..."
"She's so cool..." Every time I think that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just caught myself wondering... why I'm standing here right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "And so, it felt like the two of them were getting... farther and farther away..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I guess... it's just going to be
like this for me forever...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, even I can kind of
tell on my own.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe... the limit of my growth...
has already passed long ago..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Then there is probably no point anymore
for me to ever make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If it's going to be meaningless—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Retiring from racing, you say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“......That's all I have to say.
I'll be going now—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps the two of them are cut from the same cloth.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What you just told me, Chiyono O-san...
Those feelings... feel very similar to what I once held in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For a while after entering Tracen Academy,
even as I reached my growth phase, this body kept me
from being able to train to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As I watched everyone make their debuts,
I was constantly gripped by the anxiety of asking myself,
"Is this where it ends for me?"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... if I had remained alone,
I would have been crushed by it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You were by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because you encouraged me, supported me,
and believed in my debut—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I trained myself, believed in myself,
and was able to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...That is not all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"In the Japanese Derby,
you fought all out as my rival."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that fierce contest with you back then,
I learned that competing against a rival
allows one to surpass their limits and grow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...My 'present' is something
that Chiyono O-san connected for me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So this time,
it's my turn to connect Chiyono O-san's "now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have always believed
that you will return to the turf one day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you cannot believe in yourself,
I will keep believing in you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As your... rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Still... but still!
I haven't! I haven't run in so, so long now!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"While I was sidelined, all my potential, everything... was lost...!
So there's no way I can ever catch up anymore—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The limits you believe you have, Chiyono O-san,
can be surpassed again and again as long as you have rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just as I once did...
you, too, can surpass your "present" limits
and surely stand and compete alongside us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Something like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —The Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that upcoming race,
I will run with Yaeno-san once more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Would you please... watch that battle from up close?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Surely, there are things that cannot be said in words,
and can only be conveyed through running—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The potential you have to surpass your own limits, Chiyono O-san...
I want you to feel that through my running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting.
For you, always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hearing the details regarding Sakura Chiyono O from Mejiro Ardan,
I caught a glimpse of what she truly felt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That Chiyono O-san will make her comeback
and stand before us once more as a formidable rival.
choice_data_list: I'm sure that conviction is right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed their bond up close,
I can say this with absolute confidence.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in the "Osaka Hai."
Let's do our best in the "Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fateful race, the Osaka Hai,
is drawing closer by the second...!
